Parameters and model formula of an analysis

Source: R/show_functions.R
showParams.Rd

showParams() lists the parameters that the steps of the workflow store in a ScMaSigPro object (see ParameterConfig). showPoly() writes the full model that sc.set.poly() set up, with one coefficient beta1, beta2, ... per column of the design matrix.

Usage

showPoly(scmpObj)

showParams(scmpObj)

Arguments

scmpObj

A ScMaSigPro object.

Value

showParams(): a data frame with the columns parameters and value, one row per parameter. showPoly(): a character string.

See also

Other results: queryCoeff(), scmpResults(), showCoeff()

Examples

data("scmp.ob", package = "scMaSigPro")
head(showParams(scmp.ob))
#>         parameters                  value
#> 1    bin_ptime_col scmp_binned_pseudotime
#> 2      path_prefix                   Path
#> 3       root_label                   root
#> 4        ptime_col             Pseudotime
#> 5 selection_method               backward
#> 6       bin_method                Sturges
showPoly(scmp.ob)
#> [1] "beta0 + beta1*Path2vsPath1 + beta2*scmp_binned_pseudotime + beta3*scmp_binned_pseudotimexPath2"
